assets.prompt: Create ONE transparent production animation cutout for the Bengali series character Rafi. Reference image 1 is the canonical series character identity/style; reference image 2 is his existing approved sprite atlas. Preserve the face, tousled black hair, warm brown eyes, blue rolled-sleeve shirt, brown backpack straps and wristwatch exactly. Show Rafi waist-up SEATED, in a three-quarter view facing RIGHT, concentrating gently with eyes looking down at a silver laptop. Both forearms reach forward naturally; hands and individual fingers rest ON the keyboard with convincing contact. Include the entire open silver laptop as a prop, visibly connected to the hand action, seen from the side/back at a plausible desk angle; NO desk so the whole cutout can be composited at a workstation. Cinematic expressive 2D hand-drawn Bengali urban animation, clean dark ink lines and nuanced warm cel shading matching the existing art. Full head, elbows, both hands and laptop entirely inside canvas with generous transparent margins. One character, one laptop, no text, no labels, no environment, no ground plane, no cast shadow. Landscape canvas. Real transparent alpha.

Production animation PARTS ATLAS, clean true transparent alpha. Use the supplied canonical Bengali series lineup and existing character art as identity, costume, palette and linework references. Create EXACTLY 12 separate cutout PARTS in a strict grid of THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows on a large PORTRAIT canvas. No text, labels, borders, grid lines, scenery or shadows. Each cell contains ONE detached anatomical/wardrobe part only, centered with generous transparent gutters. ROW1 Rafi: blue rolled-sleeve shirt, brown backpack straps, charcoal trousers at waist. ROW2 Sajid: dark navy button-up shirt. ROW3 Maya: mustard yellow embroidered kurta with cream dupatta. ROW4 Manager: charcoal business suit, white shirt, navy tie. For EVERY ROW: COLUMN1 is a HEADLESS, ARMLESS torso from complete neck opening/collar and BOTH shoulder attachment caps down to waist; draw the full continuous shirt/suit/kurta surface underneath where arms would normally overlap, so the body can be animated without holes. No head and no arms attached to this torso. COLUMN2 is ONE detached UPPER ARM, vertical and straight pointing downward: rounded shoulder cap at top, sleeve covering upper arm, elbow connector at bottom; Rafi has rolled blue cuff, Sajid navy sleeve, Maya mustard embroidered sleeve, manager charcoal sleeve with white cuff. COLUMN3 is ONE detached BARE FOREARM plus relaxed OPEN HAND, vertical pointing downward: rounded elbow connector at top, natural slim forearm, wrist and five gently separated relaxed fingers pointing down at bottom, palm facing viewer with thumb on viewer's LEFT. No watches, jewelry or cuffs on this bare forearm piece. Keep parts at consistent scale WITHIN each row; torso is broader than the limb parts. Precise anatomy, natural hands, dark illustrated outlines, warm painterly cel shading matching reference, not flat geometric or 3D. The parts must be completely separated by transparent gutters and ready to assemble into a 2D articulated puppet. Invariant: exactly torso / sleeved upper arm / bare forearm-and-hand in each row, no complete people, no faces.

Create a clean transparent TALKING-HEAD PARTS ATLAS for the supplied Bengali series character references. Exactly FOUR equal-width columns in ONE row on a wide landscape canvas, one detached head plus COMPLETE natural neck in each column, all fully contained with generous alpha gutters. Left to right: Rafi, Sajid, Maya, the Manager. Preserve each face identity, hairstyle, age, skin tone, accessories and illustration style exactly from the references. Rafi: tousled black hair, youthful warm eyes, three-quarter facing RIGHT. Sajid: swept black hair, sharper eyebrows, three-quarter facing LEFT. Maya: long wavy black hair, small gold earrings, three-quarter facing RIGHT; include ALL her long hair down to its natural tapered ends. Manager: short dark hair, rectangular glasses, small moustache, three-quarter facing LEFT. All four have a calm attentive expression, eyes open, lips gently CLOSED, NO teeth and no exaggerated grin. These are speech-rig base heads, not emotional mugshots. No body, shoulders, clothing or collar attached. Neck extends naturally from jaw to a rounded base long enough to tuck underneath a shirt collar. Each actual head (hair top through chin) should be about 350 pixels tall on a 724px-tall atlas, neck about 80 pixels longer; leave remaining lower cell area transparent except Maya's long hair. Keep eyes, nose, mouth anatomically clear for animation controls. Refined hand-drawn 2D urban Bengali cartoon with ink outlines and warm subtle cel shading, matching the source art, not 3D or flat icons. Real alpha. No text, labels, frames, background, glow, cast shadow or grid lines.
